2025-06-09.riddle: I fill with air but cannot breathe, You play with me, then I may leave. I float around and pop with glee— What am I?
2025-06-09.hint: I rise at parties but don’t last long.

2025-06-10.riddle: I hide in walls, yet carry sound, Through cords and wires I’m often found. Pick me up to hear a friend— What am I?

2025-06-11.riddle: I’m hot and round and baked with care, You’ll slice me up and often share. With cheese on top, I’m quite a treat— What am I?
2025-06-11.hint: I’m often delivered in a box.

2025-06-12.riddle: I’m always hungry, must always be fed, The finger I touch will soon turn red. Give me fuel, I’ll grow higher and higher— What am I?

2025-06-13.riddle: I twist and turn but never break, You pull me close for comfort’s sake. Around your neck or tucked away— What am I?
2025-06-13.hint: I keep you warm in winter.

2025-06-14.riddle: I glide across ice, sharp and sleek, I help you dance with every tweak. I have no wheels, but I can race— What am I?

2025-06-15.riddle: I’m filled with ink, I help you write, I sign your name both day and night. I’m clicked or capped to keep me neat— What am I?
2025-06-15.hint: I live on desks and in pockets.

2025-06-16.riddle: I open wide but have no lips, I carry sharp or rounded tips. You’ll find me in kitchens or toolkits too— What am I?
